en.content.title: Regulatory Disclosures
en.sections.aml.title: 1. Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF)
en.sections.aml.p1: In compliance with European Union directives (including the 5th and 6th Anti-Money Laundering Directives) and national legislations in France and Luxembourg, Acropolis Real Estate enforces rigorous Know-Your-Customer (KYC) and AML procedures.
en.sections.aml.p2: Before initiating any transaction or formal buyer-broker engagement, we are legally required to verify the identity of our clients, including individual buyers, corporate entities, and their ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs). This verification process involves:
en.sections.aml.item1: Verification of government-issued photographic identification (passports, national ID cards).
en.sections.aml.item2: Verification of residential address (utility bills, bank statements issued within the last 3 months).
en.sections.aml.item3: Corporate registry documentation (e.g., Kbis in France, R.C.S. extract in Luxembourg) and articles of association.
en.sections.aml.item4: Clear identification of ultimate beneficial owners holding more than 25% of the shares or voting rights.
en.sections.aml.item5: Documentation verifying the legitimate source of funds and wealth involved in the acquisition.
en.sections.credentials.title: 2. Professional Credentials & Licensing
en.sections.credentials.p1: Acropolis Real Estate operates as a fully licensed and regulated real estate agency under European jurisdictions:
en.sections.credentials.france: France: Licensed under CPI No. 7501 2026 000 000 123 issued by the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCI Paris Île-de-France). Subject to the Hoguet Law (Loi n° 70-9 du 2 janvier 1970) regulating real estate transactions.
en.sections.credentials.insurance: Professional Indemnity Insurance: Covered by a comprehensive professional liability insurance policy with Allianz IARD, protecting our clients against professional errors, omissions, and negligence up to €1,500,000 per claim.
en.sections.credentials.guarantee: Financial Guarantee: We do not hold any client funds, deposits, or escrow payments. All financial transactions, reservation deposits, and final balances are securely processed directly through registered public notaries (notaires) in France or designated bank escrows in Luxembourg and Greece.

fr.sections.aml.title: 1. Lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (AML) et le financement du terrorisme (CTF)
fr.sections.aml.p1: Conformément aux directives de l'Union européenne (y compris les 5e et 6e directives de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent) et aux législations nationales en France et au Luxembourg, Acropolis Real Estate applique des procédures rigoureuses de connaissance du client (KYC) et de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (AML).
fr.sections.aml.p2: Avant d'initier toute transaction ou engagement formel d'acheteur-courtier, nous sommes légalement tenus de vérifier l'identité de nos clients, y compris les acheteurs individuels, les entités morales et leurs bénéficiaires effectifs ultimes (UBO). Ce processus de vérification comprend :
fr.sections.aml.item1: Vérification d'une pièce d'identité officielle avec photo (passeport, carte nationale d'identité).
fr.sections.aml.item2: Vérification de l'adresse résidentielle (factures de services publics, relevés bancaires émis au cours des 3 derniers mois).
fr.sections.aml.item3: Documentation du registre du commerce (ex: Kbis en France, extrait R.C.S. au Luxembourg) et statuts de la société.
fr.sections.aml.item4: Identification claire des bénéficiaires effectifs ultimes détenant plus de 25% des actions ou des droits de vote.
fr.sections.aml.item5: Documentation vérifiant la source légitime des fonds et de la richesse impliqués dans l'acquisition.
